scene.value: A small cyanotype-printing art studio in cool afternoon window light. Standing at a waist-high bench in side profile, she lifts one corner of a blue unlettered botanical print with her right hand while the left lies open on the table, hands fully separate. Blue drying prints and shallow ceramic trays make the hobby clear.

outfit.value: A white sleeveless tied-front linen shirt with a wide pointed collar, bare midriff, loose mint high-waisted culotte shorts, a thin tan belt and small leaf pin. Bare arms and legs, everyday artist clothes, no armor.

custom.value: One clearly adult woman in her 20s. Both hands fully within the chosen framing, each hand exactly one thumb and four individually separated fingers with coherent knuckles; no fused digits or extra fingers. No weapons, text, logo, border or duplicate figure.
